prompt: What does Nia ask the listener to test?

options.text: Whether the new phone can call a mobile.
options.zh: 新電話能不能打到手機。
options.whyZh: 新電話已經能撥出；這次要測試接不接得到外面打進來的電話。

options.text: Whether the installer can read the sticker.
options.zh: 安裝人員能不能看懂貼紙。
options.whyZh: 貼紙上的號碼只供安裝用，不是測試的目標。

options.text: Whether an outside call to reception reaches the new phone.
options.zh: 從外面打到接待處的電話，能不能由新電話接到。
options.whyZh: 妮亞請聽者用自己的手機打大門上的接待處號碼，確認新電話是否會響。

options.text: Whether staff can find the directory.
options.zh: 員工能不能找到通訊錄。
options.whyZh: 員工通訊錄會維持原樣；留言沒有要求測試通訊錄。

explanationZh: 妮亞請聽者用自己的手機打大門上的接待處號碼，確認新電話是否會響。
evidence: It can already call out. Making a call doesn’t show that the phone can receive one. / Please use your own mobile to call the reception number printed on our front door.

evidenceSpans.speaker: F
evidenceSpans.exactQuote: It can already call out. Making a call doesn’t show that the phone can receive one.

evidenceSpans.speaker: F
